prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a revised Goho family launcher foreground derived from this approved three-character family portrait. User concern: the current faceless tapered silhouettes look like flames or a dating-app logo. Solve through a clearly squat, ROUND, cuddly full-body grouping. Bram on left: very wide low periwinkle/lilac rounded body, two small ivory horns symmetric and low, heavy rounded hanging arms, tiny feet, no curl. Mira on right: broad coral rounded pear body, almost circular, not tall or tapered; one SMALL low sideways crown curl tucked against her rounded dome, no raised peak, no horns; rounded arm, tiny feet. Child foreground centered: small buttery-yellow rounded oval body, two tiny cream hornbuds and one tiny low curl, plump short arms and two tiny feet. All three smooth faceless: NO eyes, mouths, eyebrows, noses, facial indentations, or expressions. Retain character identity through shapes/colors/arms/horns. Parents stand at same height and form a broad horizontal pair with a visible shallow dip between their heads; child sits in front lower between them. Clearly read as three soft friendly little creatures cuddling together, with visible outer arm lobes and a few small distinct feet, not three droplets. Wide compact grouping aspect about 1.5:1. No pointed bodies, no flame tips, no diagonal rising peaks, no upward tapering silhouette, no heart symbol. Deep saturated lilac, coral and buttery yellow, cream horns. Keep soft matte clay-like 3D volume, smooth soft studio highlights and overlap shadows; restrained texture, no glossy plastic. Genuinely transparent background; no floor, text, label, badge, circle, icon plate, or background shadows. Square canvas with generous transparent margin around the full grouping, all limbs/horns/feet fully within the frame. Deliver a single polished foreground illustration, not a sheet.
